correctness.rationale: Verified the repaired pair claim from the algebra. Commutation sets the outside-neighbor coordinates to zero and equates b_v/a_v along each internal edge, giving rank |S|+|N(S)|-c(S) independently of nonzero coordinate choices and of the field. Conjugation preserves vertex coordinates. In characteristic two the independent edge coordinates of the square vanish exactly for independent S. Independent GF(2) row elimination for all 128 masks per graph gives identical ordinary histograms and differences -1,3,-3,1 only at |S|=2 and ranks 2,3,4,5. Weighting gives the stated factorization and the F_2 class vectors and 7424 totals; the field-independent rank proof extends the histogram, not just the F_2 sample. Subtracting the identity does not change the difference.
residual_risks: This proves the stated pair and formula, not a smallest-pair assertion or classification. Frozen expert, formal and external-verification markers were not performed and are not used as evidence.
